title: Magical Explorer TV Anime Reveals More Cast, October Debut, Theme Song Artist in Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Iris and Noboru Kannatsuki 's Magical Explorer light novel series revealed on Friday the anime will debut on October 3. The staff also revealed a second key visual, a second promotional video, more cast and staff, and the theme song information.
author: ANN

title: Atelier Resleriana: Forgotten Alchemy and the Polar Night Liberator Smartphone Game Ends Service in Japan on November 25
content: The game debuted for iOS and Android in Japan in September 2023, and launched globally for iOS, Android, and PC via Steam in January 2024. The English version ended service in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: A "New World" Appears in BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 46 Preview
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 6 (Episode 46 overall). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25. It is set to run for 10 episodes.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine Original TV Anime Reveals 8 More Cast Members, October 7 Debut
content: Good Smile Company announced on Friday eight new cast members for its original anime Jyuо̄ Mujin Dandivine (Beast King War God Dandivine). The company also revealed the anime will debut on Tokyo TV , BS11 , Gunma TV , and Tochigi TV on October 7 at 24:30 (effectively October 8 at 12:30 a.m.).
author: ANN

title: 'Juuou Mujin Dandivine' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the Juuou Mujin Dandivine ( Beast King War God Dandivine ) original television anime announced additional cast members on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 8 at 12:30 a.m. on Tokyo MX, BS11, Gunma TV, Tochigi TV, followed by Chukyo TV and MBS.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Now That I Can Control Reality With a Mouse Cursor Anime Anime Announced, Reveals First Trailer, Visual, October 4 Premiere
content: Now That I Can Control Reality With A Mouse Cursor, I’m Gonna Click Away On The Girls! anime was officially announced, revealing the first trailer, visual, staff, and an October 4, 2026 premiere date. The anime will air on TOKYO MX and BS11 in Japan.
author: Anime Corner

title: Kagurabachi Anime Casts Miku Ito as Hinao, Miyari Nemoto as Char, New Character Trailers and Visuals Revealed
content: KAGURABACHI anime revealed Miku Ito as Hinao and Miyari Nemoto as Char Kyonagi, along with new character visuals and individual trailers for both characters. title: Frontwing, Good Smile Co. Release Cocoro Visual Novel on Steam in English
content: Frontwing and Good Smile Company released the Cocoro visual novel on Steam on Thursday. The game features text options in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. The game retails for US$24.99 and is available for a 20% discount for a 12-day period after launch.
author: ANN

title: Arc System Works' Donutal Alien Immigration Simulation Game Reveals September 3 Debut in Trailer
content: Arc System Works revealed on Thursday that it will release its upcoming Donutal game on PC via Steam on September 3 (September 4 in Japan). Arc System Works is also streaming a new character overview trailer for the game.
author: ANN
